title: X Performance Record
description: Handoff between A18 Analytics Agent and A10-X. Metrics are grouped by the KPI tiers in kpi.md so that a report cannot open with reach. Tier 3 fields exist to explain Tier 1 and Tier 2 movement and are never reported as achievements on their own.

window_days.description: Bookmarks and profile clicks accumulate slowly. A 1-day read is a reach signal only; judge saveability at 7 and 28 days.

production_decisions.description: Copied from the post so performance is attributable to a decision, not only to a post (outputs.md handoff to Analytics).

tier_1.description: Business outcome. Phase 2 for sessions, Phase 3 for bookings. Null until measurable — and a report that omits Tier 1 must say why.

attribution_note.description: Until Phase 3, prioritisation is proxy-based and every report must say so.

tier_2.description: Authority and saveability. The tier this agent is steered by.

bookmark_to_like_ratio.description: kpi.md: likes are reflexive, bookmarks are deliberate. When they diverge, follow bookmarks.

measurement_method.description: Bookmark and profile-click data are not exposed at every X API tier. Manual entry is acceptable; substituting a proxy metric is not (integrations.md).

interpretation.description: Written by X Content Agent, not by Analytics. Analytics collects; this agent interprets.

diagnostic_pattern.description: Maps to the diagnostic matrix in kpi.md, which names the owning agent for each pattern.

hypothesis_update.description: Mandatory in the monthly report. When evidence contradicts the prior hypothesis, the hypothesis is updated — never the evidence (/AGENTS.md).

sample_caveat.description: Single-post results are not channel performance (kpi.md forbidden framings). State the sample size where a conclusion is being drawn.
